fusions.name: Raking Somersault
fusions.desc: Rakes the target as you tumble past it. It deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Tumbling Pounce
fusions.desc: Pounces on a target up to 6 tiles away and deals 30 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at maximum range. It always crits.

fusions.name: Noiseless Lap
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Second Twist
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
